description: Grades a site on 12 on-site checks for AI search. Use it when the user asks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI would recommend or cite their site, or wants a GEO audit. Pass the domain. Reads up to 10 public pages without JavaScript (robots.txt respected). Each check is pass, partial, fail or unknown with evidence and a fix: no-JS text, crawler access, llms.txt, what-is sentence, prices page, comparison page, 10 questions, Organization and Product markup, one name, named quotes, dates, an original number. Returns a score out of 12 and the 3 biggest fixes. unknown means the fetch could not prove the row and earns no point. It does not query AI engines or promise a citation. Not for private addresses.

domain.description: A public website, for example example.com or https://example.com. Only that site's public pages are read.

name: audit_ai_search

asOf.description: Date the pages were read, YYYY-MM-DD.

heuristic.description: True for a checklist convention, false for a crawl or indexing requirement.

status.description: unknown: the fetch could not reach what the row needs, so it earns nothing.

fixes.description: Up to 3 fixes, biggest point gain first.

asOf.description: Date of the cited post, YYYY-MM-DD.

score.description: Passes plus half the partials, out of 12.

title: AI search audit (12 checks)
